run_train_net: run detectron2 model training from a config file using the train_net.py entry point script
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset using the build_evaluator function with cfg and dataset_name
test_with_TTA: test a trained model with test-time augmentation using the Trainer.test_with_TTA class method
setup_config: setup detectron2 configuration by merging a config file and command line options using the setup function
run_eval_only: run evaluation only mode by passing eval_only flag to train_net.py with a pre-trained model checkpoint
